# agent-router-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for Agent Router, formerly Envoy AI Gateway (AI gateway routes, AI service backends, MCP routes, policies).

> **Formerly [Envoy AI Gateway](https://github.com/envoyproxy/ai-gateway).** CRD API group: `aigateway.envoyproxy.io`.
> Upstream's own CRD chart, `oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/ai-gateway-crds-helm`, keeps the former name; to switch from it,
> see [Already have these CRDs?](#already-have-these-crds). Then do **not** `helm uninstall` the old
> release: it would delete the CRDs and every custom resource. Delete only its release record:
> `kubectl delete secret -n <old-namespace> -l owner=helm,name=<old-release>`.

CRDs are copied verbatim from [theagentrouter/agent-router](https://github.com/theagentrouter/agent-router)
at tag [`v1.2.0`](https://github.com/theagentrouter/agent-router/tree/v1.2.0) (commit `daa9f891a8afcb18576d4593ad18870d1d18abac`),
path(s) `manifests/charts/ai-gateway-crds-helm/templates`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install agent-router oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/agent-router-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install agent-router oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/agent-router-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd aigatewayroutes.aigateway.envoyproxy.io aiservicebackends.aigateway.envoyproxy.io backendsecuritypolicies.aigateway.envoyproxy.io gatewayconfigs.aigateway.envoyproxy.io mcproutes.aigateway.envoyproxy.io quotapolicies.aigateway.envoyproxy.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd aigatewayroutes.aigateway.envoyproxy.io aiservicebackends.aigateway.envoyproxy.io backendsecuritypolicies.aigateway.envoyproxy.io gatewayconfigs.aigateway.envoyproxy.io mcproutes.aigateway.envoyproxy.io quotapolicies.aigateway.envoyproxy.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `annotations` | object | `{}` | Extra annotations added to every CRD. |
| `labels` | object | `{}` | Extra labels added to every CRD. |
| `keepOnUninstall` | bool | `true` | Add `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` so CRDs (and all their custom resources) survive `helm uninstall`. |

Unknown keys are rejected (`values.schema.json`).
